data.one_liner: A Flutter tile widget featuring a built-in customizable corner banner and multiple layout options.
data.what_it_does: Creates list tiles with an integrated corner banner for tags like 'New' or 'Hot'. It supports image containers, titles, subtitles, trailing widgets, and custom shapes like zigzag borders.
use_when: You need a custom list tile displaying a corner badge or banner tag.
You want easy customization for tile backgrounds, border radiuses, and banner positions.
avoid_when: You need complex data grids or standard Material ListTiles without custom banners.
strengths: Built-in banner positioning and customizable tags with text or icons.
Supports zigzag image shapes and flexible layouts.
Includes various customization parameters like elevation, side borders, and margins.
weaknesses: Requires manual height configuration when used as a single standalone widget outside of a vertical list.
Niche widget with limited use cases beyond tagged list items.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import it.
data.minimal_example:
BannerListTile(
  backgroundColor: Colors.blue,
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
  bannerPosition: BannerPosition.topRight,
  title: Text("Lisa"),
  subtitle: Text("A model from NY"),
)
